text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean quantile score of the physics core minus XGBoost per half-hour (points of capacity; positive: XGBoost better). Panels 1 to 4 use the held-out-year fits with ERA5 as the weather; the last panel uses the scored cases.'

positive: XGBoost better). Panels 1 to 4 use the held-out-year fits with ERA5 as the weather;
